cairnryan_ferry_clerk.text: Ferry Terminal. Tickets for Belfast and Larne. The ship is the bit you will remember.
Most sailings moved here from Stranraer, further down the loch, in 2011.
Cairnryan was built up as a military port in the Second World War, because it is sheltered and on the west coast, away from the worst of the bombing.

cairnryan_ferry_driver.text: I come through every Thursday. Four hours of road, two hours of sea, one enormous breakfast.
